notes: Scoresheet columns are labeled 'G F P Pts' (field goals made, free throws made, personal fouls, points) — no attempt counts given, so fg/ft store made-count only (as plain numeric strings, not 'made-attempted'). Per-row Pts values were verified against 2*FG+FT for every player with nonzero scoring; both team Pts columns cross-checked exactly against final scores (Ohio State 44, Army 30). Note: the printed team-total row at the bottom of each roster (e.g. 'G F P Pts' totals '17 12 10 44' for OSU) does not sum cleanly to the same G/F/P split as the individual rows — likely an original-document column-total transcription quirk — but this does not affect player-level values or the final-score checksum, which is what was used to validate. Ohio State's 'Minutes Played' side table (separate box on the page) supplied the min field for OSU players only; Army had no minutes table. One OSU player name is partly obscured by an ink dot but is unambiguous via the adjacent Minutes Played list ('Ervin', 'Schuler').
